# What a generated family's build refuses. Each is found while the build walks
# a host at build time, so each is a build error with the position that caused
# it rather than a check error: the checker does not know which target a build
# picks, and one override answers for any target it names.

# A member's prop is read at build time, and state has no value then that it
# will have when the program runs.
! sngl generate -o out state.sngl
stderr 'state.sngl:29:17: an emitted family is written at build time, and n is state the program changes as it runs'

# The family says how it is generated for Go; bubbletea's build finds it. A
# target the family says nothing about would get a host nothing renders.
! sngl generate --lang none --platform html -o out state_free.sngl
stderr 'state_free.sngl:26:1: bar is generated by the block family''s emitter, which has no override for platform html with language none'

# A bodyless member reached by the walk says what it writes for the target
# being built, or the file would be missing it without a word. One with a body
# composes instead.
! sngl generate -o out member_silent.sngl
stderr 'member_silent.sngl:36:8: the block family emits for platform bubbletea with language go, and gap says nothing about what it writes'

# The walk reads hosts at the root of a file; one a component renders would
# reach a code generator as a bodyless node.
! sngl generate -o out nested.sngl
stderr 'nested.sngl:27:5: bar is generated by its family''s emitter, which reads it only where it is written at the root of a file'

-- state.sngl --
import build "sngl:build"
import gen "sngl:x/gen"
import go "sngl:language/go"
import ui "sngl:ui"

output {
    go {
        bubbletea
    }
}

component block build.family

component text(full string) block

component bar(blocks ...component block) root

component block[go.language] {
    gen.emit(file="blocks.txt")
}

component text[go.language] {
    gen.node(open="{full}\n")
}

var n = 1

bar {
    text(full="{n}")
}

ui.window {
    ui.text(value="{n}", @click { n += 1 })
}
-- state_free.sngl --
import build "sngl:build"
import gen "sngl:x/gen"
import go "sngl:language/go"
import ui "sngl:ui"

output {
    go {
        bubbletea
    }
}

component block build.family

component text(full string) block

component bar(blocks ...component block) root

component block[go.language] {
    gen.emit(file="blocks.txt")
}

component text[go.language] {
    gen.node(open="{full}\n")
}

bar {
    text(full="x")
}

ui.window {
    ui.text(value="hi")
}
-- member_silent.sngl --
import build "sngl:build"
import gen "sngl:x/gen"
import go "sngl:language/go"
import html "sngl:platform/html"
import ui "sngl:ui"

output {
    go {
        bubbletea
    }
}

component block build.family

component text(full string) block

component gap() block

// What it writes on html says nothing about what it writes on bubbletea.
component gap[html.platform] {
    gen.node(open=" ")
}

component bar(blocks ...component block) root

component block[go.language] {
    gen.emit(file="blocks.txt")
}

component text[go.language] {
    gen.node(open="{full}\n")
}

bar {
    text(full="x")
    gap()
}

ui.window {
    ui.text(value="hi")
}
-- nested.sngl --
import build "sngl:build"
import gen "sngl:x/gen"
import go "sngl:language/go"
import ui "sngl:ui"

output {
    go {
        bubbletea
    }
}

component block build.family

component text(full string) block

component bar(blocks ...component block) root

component block[go.language] {
    gen.emit(file="blocks.txt")
}

component text[go.language] {
    gen.node(open="{full}\n")
}

component shell() root {
    bar {
        text(full="x")
    }
    ui.window {
        ui.text(value="hi")
    }
}

shell()
